main_body: A round bush or leaf-canopy blob with no trunk, filling the whole 48-row sprite
top_band: none: the greens are mottled across all rows with no distinct lighter horizontal top band over a front face
evidence: Reading a column through the middle, I get a random mix of light, mid and dark greens from the top row to the bottom. There is no top surface, no step at a front edge, and no separate south face, so the whole thing reads as a flat leaf-mass seen from above. The bush has no lit crown over a shaded front, and no trunk or base to give a front face. It fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The candidate uses about 4 greens in a noisy dither with no readable leaf clumps and no light-to-shadow structure across the volume. The reference trees group leaves into lit clumps with dark-green gaps and a visible trunk. The candidate's outline is a uniform near-black line around the whole silhouette, which gives the sticker look. The reference uses dark green and brown tones instead. The mottling avoids large flat fills, but each tile carries only about 5 colours, which is below the reference.
